_about: Clean-room reference of cross-layer transitions, kdenlive-informed. We currently have NONE of these. Modeled in our app as per-layer in/out transitions that blend a layer with what is below it (stacked layers compose back-to-front). renderTechnique: opacity | mask | geometry | composite. See IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

transitions.name: Dissolve (cross-fade)
transitions.summary: Fade the layer in/out by animating its opacity; over an overlap with the layer beneath this reads as a cross-dissolve.

transitions.name: Wipe (directional)
transitions.summary: Directional reveal via an animated alpha gradient. Reuse the existing Wipe effect math (applyWipe in effects.ts).

transitions.name: Slide / Push
transitions.summary: Translate the layer in from an edge (or push). Offset animates from off-frame to its resting transform over the duration.

transitions.name: Luma / Gradient wipe
transitions.summary: Reveal driven by a luma map: pixels appear as an animated threshold sweeps the map's brightness. Start with built-in synthetic gradients (linear/radial/clock); custom luma PNGs later.

transitions.name: Composite (blend mode)
transitions.summary: Not really a timed transition; a blend mode between a layer and what is below (normal/multiply/screen/overlay). We already have BlendMode on ColorPatch — generalize it to all layers.

transitions.name: Affine (transform)
transitions.summary: Animated position/scale/rotation move-in. Largely covered by our existing keyframeable transform; expose as a one-click in/out preset.

transitions.name: Matte / Track matte
transitions.summary: Use one layer's alpha/luma as the matte for another. Larger feature; document as future. Not a timed transition.

_omitted.mix: audio crossfade — out of scope (no audio pipeline)
_omitted.vqm: video quality measurement — not a transition
